notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.content:
This update adds the following list of changes:
1. Add interactivity of the interface
2. New game elements:
  * Bombs
  * Traps
3. New levels + bonus
4. Fixed bugs with cursor
5. Fixed bugs with the "Statistics" section
6. Optimization is performed
7. Fixed font in main menu
